# Bahrain Grand Prix Preview

Verstappen hunts a fifth consecutive victory as McLaren pursues Red Bull's fragile grip on the constructors' championship at the Sakhir circuit. Norris and Leclerc clash for the remaining podium real estate while Sainz exploits tire degradation patterns that punished frontrunners throughout practice. A dominant Red Bull performance extends their title buffer to an insurmountable lead; a McLaren triumph tightens the constructors' fight to fewer than 20 points separating the teams heading into the final two races.
